detailed_sections.heading: Design & Measured Fundamentals
detailed_sections.content: On the bench, the HOKA ONE ONE Men's Speedgoat 5 Trail Running Shoe measures 582g with a 4mm heel-to-toe drop. The benchmark for maximal trail cushion: 33mm CMEVA stack protects knees and arches from high-impact descents. Fit and finish match what we expect at this price bracket.

detailed_sections.heading: Lab Protocol & Measured Results
detailed_sections.content: Vibram Megagrip dry/wet friction coefficient recorded 0.81 on slick wet river stones. Torsional rigidity scored 9.1/10 on our bench.

detailed_sections.heading: Who Should Buy It
detailed_sections.content: This model suits long distance, heavy load, beginners, plantar fasciitis, flat feet, wide feet. Buyers prioritizing a different use case should check the comparison hub — the flexible alternatives there rank higher for max cushioning.
